en_title: Bethesda Boss Issues Memo to Staff After Xbox Moves Obsidian Into the Fallout Company
cn_title: 《辐射》黑曜石并入贝塞斯达，负责人发信安抚员工
subtitle: 仍保留独立身份
opus_summary: XBOX工作室重组后，黑曜石并入贝塞斯达。贝塞斯达负责人在内部信中表示，黑曜石将保留管理层和独立身份，贝塞斯达游戏工作室则继续主导《辐射》系列；黑曜石也在开发一款《辐射》游戏。

paragraphs.en: The boss of Bethesda has issued a memo to staff reassuring them that Obsidian Entertainment remains “distinct” despite being absorbed into the company as part of this week’s seismic Xbox studios reorganisation.
paragraphs.cn: 本周XBOX旗下工作室经历重大重组，黑曜石并入贝塞斯达。贝塞斯达负责人向员工发出内部信，表示黑曜石仍将保持「独立」。

paragraphs.en: This week, Microsoft announced hundreds more layoffs as it gutted Halo Studios and handed the next mainline Halo game, Sea of Thieves developer Rare, and Age of Empires developer World's Edge to Activision . Meanwhile, Obsidian, the Microsoft-owned studio behind the likes of Grounded, The Outer Worlds, and Avowed, was made a part of Bethesda.
paragraphs.cn: 本周，微软宣布再裁员数百人，大幅缩减《光环》工作室，并将下一部《光环》正统续作、《盗贼之海》开发商Rare以及《帝国时代》开发商World's Edge交给Activision。与此同时，曾开发《禁闭求生》《天外世界》和《宣誓》等游戏的微软旗下工作室黑曜石被并入贝塞斯达。

paragraphs.en: Obsidian, perhaps most famous for developing the much-loved Fallout: New Vegas, was confirmed to be working on a Fallout game in the wake of new Xbox boss Asha Sharma’s “reset” of Microsoft’s gaming business, which has seen nearly 2,000 staff cut in a bid for improved financial performance. More staff are set to lose their jobs over the course of the rest of the current financial year.
paragraphs.cn: 黑曜石或许最为人熟知的作品是备受喜爱的《辐射：新维加斯》。在XBOX新负责人Asha Sharma对微软游戏业务展开「重整」后，黑曜石确认正在开发一款《辐射》游戏。为改善财务表现，微软已裁减近2,000名员工；在本财年剩余时间里，还将有更多员工失业。

paragraphs.en: Bringing Obsidian into the Bethesda fold makes sense given it’s working on Fallout, but some had worried the move signalled an eventual relegation to Fallout support studio status. But in a memo to staff viewed by IGN, Bethesda boss Jill Braff insisted Obsidian would retain its leadership and identity, while confirming Bethesda Game Studios would “continue to lead the Fallout franchise.”
paragraphs.cn: 考虑到黑曜石正在开发《辐射》游戏，将其并入贝塞斯达并不难理解，但有人担心，这可能意味着黑曜石最终会沦为《辐射》系列的辅助开发工作室。不过，在IGN看到的内部信中，贝塞斯达负责人Jill Braff强调，黑曜石将保留自己的管理层和独立身份；她同时确认，贝塞斯达游戏工作室将「继续主导《辐射》系列」。

paragraphs.en: There is of course a huge amount going on at Bethesda right now, with The Elder Scrolls 6 the focus. Fallout 5 is in pre-production. BGS has also confirmed Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas remasters are in the works. No release windows are known for any of these games, nor Obsidian’s Fallout game.
paragraphs.cn: 贝塞斯达目前还有大量项目在推进，重点是《上古卷轴6》。《辐射5》处于前期制作阶段。贝塞斯达游戏工作室也已确认，《辐射3》和《辐射：新维加斯》的复刻版正在开发中。这些游戏以及黑曜石开发的《辐射》游戏，目前都没有公布发售时间窗口。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, BGS has said Starfield "continues," although Bethesda stopped short of confirming a sequel is in the works.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，贝塞斯达游戏工作室表示，《星空》「还会继续」，但贝塞斯达并未确认续作是否正在开发。

paragraphs.en: The Xbox “reset” has left Xbox Game Studios a shadow of its former self, with a number of previously owned studios either independent, moved into Activision or Bethesda, or set for closure. Will Gears of War studio The Coalition, which suffered layoffs this week , Clockwork Revolution developer inXile, and Fable and Forza Horizon developer Playground eventually also end up at either Activision or Bethesda?
paragraphs.cn: 经过这次XBOX「重整」，XBOX游戏工作室已今非昔比：多家原本隶属旗下的工作室或独立，或并入Activision与贝塞斯达，或面临关闭。本周遭遇裁员的《战争机器》开发商The Coalition、《发条革命》开发商inXile，以及《神鬼寓言》和《极限竞速：地平线》开发商Playground，最终是否也会并入Activision或贝塞斯达？
